title: 2011 AMC 8 Problem 21
statement: Students guess that Norb’s age is \(24,\) \(28,\) \(30,\) \(32,\) \(36,\) \(38,\) \(41,\) \(44,\) \(47,\) and \(49.\) Norb says, “At least half of you guessed too low, two of you are off by one, and my age is a prime number.” How old is Norb?

solutions.text:
The first part of the statement means that Norb’s age is greater than \(36.\)

The second part means that Norb’s age is either between \(36\) and \(38\) or between \(47\) and \(49.\)

Since \(37\) is prime and \(48\) is not, Norb’s age is \(37.\)

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: The two guesses off by one force Norb near either \(37\) or \(48\).
At least half too low puts Norb above the fifth listed guess.
